scripts.check:fonts: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage/fonts', { recursive: true })" && python -m coverage run --data-file=coverage/fonts/.coverage --branch --source=scripts scripts/subset-website-fonts.py --check && python -m coverage xml --data-file=coverage/fonts/.coverage -o coverage/fonts/coverage.xml && python -m coverage report --data-file=coverage/fonts/.coverage --fail-under=80
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:governance
